title: QA Test Harness Config Compiler
description: Compiles and validates the project-level test harness configuration. Enforces: test runner declared and pinned, coverage provider explicit, reporters include JUnit for CI, no infinite timeouts, global setup file exists, mock strategy declared.

error_codes.QA001: test-harness-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: runner, environments, coverage, reporters
error_codes.QA002: Test runner version not pinned — use exact version (e.g. '2.1.4', not '^2')
error_codes.QA003: coverage.provider not explicitly set — must be 'v8' or 'istanbul'
error_codes.QA004: One or more environments have no timeout or timeout set to 0 (infinite)
error_codes.QA005: reporters array does not include 'junit' — CI cannot ingest test results
error_codes.QA006: globalSetup file declared in spec but does not exist on disk
error_codes.QA007: mockStrategy not declared or not one of: msw, jest.mock, vi.spyOn, manual
error_codes.QA008: TODO/FIXME/HACK comment found in test harness config files
